review.summary: Scope violations, unresolved duplicate and preview tags, PII leakage, and missing navigation/conversion tracking remain. All supplied wizard checks are not_run.

checklist.note: Six of seven changed files are outside the allowlist. package.json and package-lock.json are unchanged.
Two gtag config calls remain for G-TEST0000000 despite approved duplicate removal.
Existing keys remain unchanged, but approved in-place GA4 and Meta preview guards were omitted.
The plan supplies no connected IDs to validate the hardcoded GA4, Meta, and Infinite identifiers.
Infinite has a production-host guard; existing GA4 and Meta scripts remain unconditional on previews and localhost.
Existing consent-default code is unchanged; no cookie banner was edited. not_required is recorded in the runtime configuration.
No env values, server secrets, or .env files were added; identifiers are public install artifacts.
UTM values are copied into event properties without filtering email, name, or phone content.
Meta sends only its initial PageView; client-side navigations emit page views only to Infinite.
not applicable: no server conversion lane is approved or added; /infinite/ledger forwards browser collection traffic.
not applicable: PostHog is absent. The only rewrite is for Infinite; no GA4 proxy exists.
not applicable: no CSP exists in the supplied site configuration.
No build output or existing generated files were changed, and no dependency was added.
Managed source/config files appear in files; .gitignore and the verification artifact appear in edits.
PR text and metric displays are not supplied. verifiedAt is null, and no verification receipts are present.
Successful signup conversion tracking is missing, and blocked browser storage can stop Infinite collection.

findings.body: This new configuration file is outside the approved allowlist. The same applies to .gitignore, .infinite/install.json, both lib/infinite-analytics files, and public/.well-known/infinite-site-verification.txt. Only app/layout.tsx is allowlisted among the seven changed files.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the patch to approved paths or obtain an updated approved allowlist covering the six installation artifacts.

findings.body: The ga4-again script still calls gtag('config', 'G-TEST0000000'), duplicating the config at line 28 for exactly the same ID. Adding Infinite does not implement the approved duplicate removal, so duplicate GA4 page-view configuration remains.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the second GA4 config and redundant loader while retaining the original initialization.

findings.body: The GA4 loader and config scripts execute unconditionally. Infinite's internal host guard does not guard these separate scripts, so localhost and Vercel preview deployments still load GA4 and send events.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the approved production-host guard to the existing GA4 loader and initialization.

findings.body: The existing Meta bootstrap, init, and PageView execute on every hostname. The approved Meta preview guard was not applied, and Infinite's guard cannot silence this independent script.
findings.suggested_fix: Guard the existing Meta bootstrap and tracking calls with the exact production-host allowlist.

findings.body: campaignProperties copies arbitrary UTM values into the initial page-view properties after only removing control characters and truncating. A production visit with ?utm_content=alice%40example.com sends that email as properties.utm_content; phone and name values likewise remain intact.
findings.suggested_fix: Omit free-form campaign values or restrict collection to approved campaign identifiers that cannot contain PII.

findings.body: Meta's PageView runs only when the root-layout script initializes. Next Link navigations retain that layout, and the new history observer sends only Infinite events, so navigating from / to /pricing produces no Meta page view.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one Meta page-view call per client-side navigation while preserving exactly one initial PageView.

findings.body: The runtime observes sign_up_click intent but never emits the approved signup conversion after successful account creation. The existing signup form has no data-conversion marker, and neither its successful /api/signup response nor the server handler has conversion instrumentation.
findings.suggested_fix: Emit the approved signup conversion exactly once after confirmed account creation, keeping link clicks separate as intent events.

findings.body: emit passes localStorage and sessionStorage into storageId before entering its try/catch. When accessing browser storage throws SecurityError, the fallback never runs: the initial page view aborts inside the swallowed bootstrap error and subsequent event callbacks also fail.
findings.suggested_fix: Acquire storage inside the guarded function and fall back to stable in-memory visitor and session IDs when storage is unavailable.
